# Test fixtures

`sample.msg` is the `ascii.msg` fixture from the MIT-licensed
[`msg_parser`](https://crates.io/crates/msg_parser) crate (v0.3.6). It is used to
test Outlook MSG parsing and `MSG -> Markdown` conversion.

msg_parser: Copyright (c) Marirs, MIT License.

`sample.djvu` is `boy.djvu` from the `djvu-rs` test corpus, sourced from the
Unlicense-licensed djvu.js project. `sample.heic` is `flat-64.heic` from the
MIT/Apache-2.0 `heic-rs` test fixtures. `alice.mobi` is the Project Gutenberg
Kindle edition of *Alice's Adventures in Wonderland* (public domain). `legacy.doc`
was generated locally with LibreOffice from a short test paragraph.
